items.source:
XDELEX is an extension of the Redis Streams XDEL command that provides more control over how message entries
are deleted concerning consumer groups.
items.translation: XDELEX 是 Redis Streams XDEL 命令的扩展，它提供了对消息条目删除方式的更多控制，特别是在涉及消费者组时。

items.source:
XACKDEL combines the functionality of XACK and XDEL in Redis Streams. It acknowledges the specified entry IDs in the
given consumer group and simultaneously attempts to delete the corresponding entries from the stream.
items.translation: XACKDEL 结合了 Redis Streams 中 XACK 和 XDEL 的功能。它会在指定的消费者组中确认给定的条目 ID，并尝试同时从流中删除相应的条目。

items.source: list of RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult for each ID: RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult.NOT_FOUND if no such ID exists, RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult.DELETED if the entry was deleted, RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult.NOT_DELETED_UNACKNOWLEDGED_OR_STILL_REFERENCED if the entry was not deleted but there are still dangling references (ACKED deletion policy). Returns null when used in pipeline / transaction.
items.translation: 每个 ID 对应的 RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult 列表：若该 ID 不存在，则为 RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult.NOT_FOUND；若条目已被删除，则为 RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult.DELETED；若条目未被删除但仍有悬空引用（适用于 ACKED 删除策略），则为 RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult.NOT_DELETED_UNACKNOWLEDGED_OR_STILL_REFERENCED。在管道或事务中使用此方法时返回 null。

items.source: list of RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult for each ID: RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult.DELETED if the entry was acknowledged and deleted, RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult.NOT_FOUND if no such ID exists, RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult.NOT_DELETED_UNACKNOWLEDGED_OR_STILL_REFERENCED if the entry was acknowledged but not deleted (when using ACKED deletion policy). Returns null when used in pipeline / transaction.
items.translation: 每个 ID 对应的 RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult 列表：若条目已确认并删除，则为 RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult.DELETED；若不存在该 ID，则为 RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult.NOT_FOUND；若条目已确认但未删除（在使用 ACKED 删除策略时），则为 RedisStreamCommands.StreamEntryDeletionResult.NOT_DELETED_UNACKNOWLEDGED_OR_STILL_REFERENCED。在管道/事务中使用此方法时返回 null。
